intro:
You keep track of which team owns which backend service and how the services depend on each other.

Initial specification:
- [e001] Decision: the owning team of cart-svc is now `team-data`.
- [e002] After the review, the team settled on `team-mobile` for the owning team of rank-svc.
- [e003] Update from Femi: the owning team of report-gen is set to `team-core`, effective now.
- [e004] Update from Jun: the owning team of audit-log is set to `team-data`, effective now.
- [e005] After the review, the team settled on `team-infra` for the owning team of quota-svc.
- [e006] From now on, the dependencies of cart-svc include `rank-svc`.
- [e007] From now on, the dependencies of rank-svc include `report-gen`.
- [e008] Added to the dependencies of audit-log: `quota-svc`.
- [e009] Tove added `cart-svc` to the dependencies of quota-svc.
- [e010] Agreed in the sync: the on-call engineer for cart-svc becomes `chen`.
- [e011] Mei confirmed in writing that the on-call engineer for rank-svc changes to `femi`.

Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
